parts.name: Base_Cup
parts.notes: AZ pedestal. Step at z 40 (r 92-104) is the greased thrust face; 208 mm bore is the journal. 6x M6 in the foot flange for a mount plate. Nut traps for the flange-plate bolts open on the outside.

parts.name: Az_Retainer_Ring
parts.notes: Wide flange plate (12x M4x20 + nuts in the pedestal wall) trapping the puck lip: uplift + moment, and the visible AZ seam.

parts.name: Az_Ring_Gear
parts.notes: Internal ring gear 80 T module 2; 6x M4x12 from below, nuts slid into the inner face slots.

parts.name: Sensor_Sun_Gear
parts.notes: Fixed sun of the AZ encoder train: D-flat press fit, a drop of CA; the puck retains it axially.

parts.name: SlipRing_Capsule_22mm
parts.notes: 22 mm flanged capsule slip ring (bought).

parts.name: Arm_R_1
parts.notes: Lower yoke arm (R). Foot bolts (4x M4x25) come up from under the yoke plate into side-loaded nuts; tenon + 2x M4x40 to the shoulder.

parts.name: Arm_R_2
parts.notes: Shoulder segment (R): pillow block top, on-axis cap, servo pocket behind the lower cover. All nuts side-loaded (traps on the Y faces, from the bore, from the servo pocket).

parts.name: Arm_L_1
parts.notes: Lower yoke arm (L). Foot bolts (4x M4x25) come up from under the yoke plate into side-loaded nuts; tenon + 2x M4x40 to the shoulder.

parts.name: Arm_L_2
parts.notes: Shoulder segment (L): pillow block top, on-axis cap. All nuts side-loaded (traps on the Y faces, from the bore, from the servo pocket).

parts.name: El_Bearing_Cap_R
parts.notes: Rounded pillow-block cap, 2x M4x20 into nuts trapped in the shoulder; holds the upper bushing half.

parts.name: El_Bushing_R_Lower
parts.notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

parts.name: El_Bushing_R_Upper
parts.notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

parts.name: El_Bearing_Cap_L
parts.notes: Rounded pillow-block cap, 2x M4x20 into nuts trapped in the shoulder; holds the upper bushing half.

parts.name: El_Bushing_L_Lower
parts.notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

parts.name: El_Bushing_L_Upper
parts.notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

parts.name: El_Axis_Cap_R
parts.notes: Right axis cap over the stub end; 4x M3x12 into bore-loaded nuts.

parts.name: El_Axis_Cap_L
parts.notes: Left axis cap: AS5600 column (2 mm off the stub magnet), translucent window; 4x M3x12 into bore-loaded nuts.

parts.name: Status_Window
parts.notes: Translucent disc in the left cap.

parts.name: El_Servo_Cover
parts.notes: Round cover over the servo pocket; integral spacer holds the servo. 4x M3x12 into pocket-loaded nuts.

parts.name: El_Servo_placeholder
parts.notes: Your servo (placeholder box) inside the right shoulder.

parts.name: Head_Puck
parts.notes: Rotating deck: 15 mm journal lip + thrust face (grease). Nuts for the deck hardware sit in hex pockets on its underside.

parts.name: SlipRing_Stub_Clamp
parts.notes: Hex split collar keyed into the puck; M3x16 pinch bolt + nut.

parts.name: Az_Servo_Clamp
parts.notes: Saddle pinning the AZ servo; 2x M3x35 through the deck into underside nuts.

parts.name: Az_Drum
parts.notes: Rotating azimuth housing (same diameter as the pedestal) = electronics bay. 4 pillars + ribs carry the yoke; M4x30 from below, M4x16 from above, nuts trapped in the pillars.

parts.name: Logo_Light_Pipe
parts.notes: Curved translucent plate behind the drum stencil (glue), LED behind.

parts.name: Yoke_Plate
parts.notes: Broad yoke base / drum lid: pillars 4x M4x16 from above (nuts in the pillars), arm feet 4x M4x25 each from below (nuts in the arm feet), round access cover 6x M3x25 (nuts under the plate).

parts.name: Yoke_Access_Cover
parts.notes: Round access cover on the yoke plate; 6x M3x25 + nuts under the plate.

parts.name: Az_Servo_placeholder
parts.notes: Your servo (placeholder box).

parts.name: Sensor_Gear_Keeper
parts.notes: Retains the AZ sensor gear on its pin; 2x M3x45 from the deck, nuts in the keeper.

parts.name: Az_Pinion
parts.notes: 20 T module 2; M3x10 axial screw into the servo's own shaft thread.

parts.name: El_Gear
parts.notes: 72 T module 2 bolted to the right hub wall (4x M4x20, nuts inside the hub).

parts.name: El_Pinion
parts.notes: 20 T module 2 on the EL servo shaft; M3x10 axial into the servo's shaft thread.

parts.name: Sensor_Idler
parts.notes: Runs on the M4x45 axle.

parts.name: Sensor_Gear
parts.notes: 1:1 with the sun; carries the AZ AS5600 magnet.

parts.name: Cradle_Hub
parts.notes: Hollow faceted hub, open top with a bolted lid: every flange bolt (stubs, gear, boom, counterweight arm) ends in a nut inside the cavity.

parts.name: Cradle_Lid
parts.notes: Hub lid, 4x M3x20 into nuts trapped in the hub walls. Fit after all flange nuts are in.

parts.name: El_Stub_R
parts.notes: EL stub axle, flange 4x M4x20 through the hub wall into nuts inside; turns in the split bushings.

parts.name: El_Stub_L
parts.notes: EL stub axle, flange 4x M4x20 through the hub wall into nuts inside; turns in the split bushings. Magnet in the end face.

parts.name: Dish_Boom
parts.notes: Square boom to the dish offset; root flange 4x M4x20 into nuts inside the hub; round end flange takes either adapter (4x M5 + nuts).

parts.name: Counterweight_Arm
parts.notes: Square tube with a row of M4 holes for the canister collar; root flange 4x M4x20 into nuts inside the hub.

parts.name: Dish_Adapter_Plate
parts.notes: Adapter A: slotted plate; 4x M5x20 + nuts.

parts.name: Dish_Adapter_PipeStub
parts.notes: Adapter B: 48.3 mm pipe stub.

parts.name: Counterweight_Canister
parts.notes: Translucent canister (~1.3 L); collar 2x M4x55 + nuts; cap 2x M3x10 with nuts inside the rim.

parts.name: Counterweight_Cap
parts.notes: Press cap, engraved PERIGEE; 2x M3x10 + nuts.

parts.name: Dish_Reference_1m
parts.notes: Reference paraboloid, not printed.

parts.name: Feed_Reference
parts.notes: LNB / feed placeholder.
